sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, as it provides valuable stability for both our companies. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to offer €51.30 for the extended 24-month term.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure to work together with your valued firm, building on the strong foundation of our shared history over many years. We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and serving your needs with the high quality you expect from our foundry craft.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer, but the small adjustment does not reflect the realities of our production costs. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

To keep our negotiations moving forward, we are willing to make a further concession to a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. We ask for a more substantial step from your side to reach an agreement that sustains our high-quality standards and long-standing partnership. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to work together with your esteemed company. In recognition of our valued 12-year partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.60 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot provides a price of €50.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 7 days.

Our family foundry takes great pride in the quality we deliver to our region and long-standing partners. To bridge the remaining gap, we respectfully request a more significant step from your side to reach a mutually viable agreement. We hope this proposal reflects our deep commitment to our shared history and future cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
